reason: A bent metal frame seems like a practical start for a place to sit and work.
expectation: The brake will shape the stock into a frame, though I don't know whether it is for a seat or a table.

alternatives.reason: The trough former directly addresses the growing goal, but I want to start with the workspace.

effect: The stock became frame sections, so I can assemble them with the paving blocks.
reaction: That matches my expectation, though their final use is still unclear.
reason: The blocks and frame sections look like a way to make a sturdy work surface or seat.
expectation: I expect a piece of furniture using the blocks as a surface or support.

alternatives.reason: Felt and fabric might make a cushion, but I want the structure first.

effect: The frame and blocks made a bare window bench; it looks like the seat needs finishing.
reaction: It's satisfying that the earlier paving material is reused as furniture.
reason: Felt and fabric naturally suggest padding for the bare bench.
expectation: I expect a cushion or padded covering.

alternatives.reason: I also need the troughs, but want to finish the bench first.

effect: The felt and fabric made the expected cushion, ready to fit to the bench.
reaction: The construction is straightforward and easy to picture.
reason: A cushion belongs on the bare bench and should finish the sitting place.
expectation: I expect a cushioned window seat and perhaps completion of the sitting and working goal.

effect: The bench is both a worktop and a seat, completing the first goal; I can now focus on the troughs.
reaction: The sunset image makes the practical furniture feel like a welcome place to live.
reason: The trough former is the only gameplay option and directly addresses the remaining goal.
expectation: It will bend the stock into one or more unlined growing troughs.

effect: The former produced growing troughs, which can now be lined.
reaction: It is a predictable but sensible fabrication step.
reason: The food-safe liner should make the troughs suitable for growing and easier to wash; it is the only gameplay option.
expectation: I expect lined washable troughs and completion of the remaining goal.

effect: The liner completed the washable troughs and the chapter.
reaction: The result is clear, though I wanted a little more sense of what would grow in them.

mostWorthwhile.text: Finishing the window bench was most worthwhile: the image of sitting to watch the sun set made the constructed object feel meaningful in daily life.

leastWorthwhile.text: Forming and lining the troughs felt quite mechanical; both steps were predictable and had no accompanying detail about their eventual use.

surprise.text: I had thought of the bench as a seat, so learning that it also has a worktop clarified how it meets both needs.

arbitrary.text: None felt purposeless; the offered materials and equipment generally suggested their uses, although the frame's exact destination was initially unclear.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see what the growing space becomes and how the expedition develops, although this chapter's combinations were straightforward rather than challenging.
